packet: H4b5b treasury-backed remittance of direct tax-account payable
scope: One explicit tax_claim_remittance fact references exactly one actual cash_out and one claim_account whose opponent is a tax_account.
The positive amount is currency-precision exact; source and claim account must share economic entity and currency, and cash_out.to_party must equal claim_account.opponent.
The fact reduces claim payable by amount and increases net by amount, while adding allocated by amount exactly once to the existing cash_out.z_allocations root.
The cash_out remains the sole treasury debit. The remittance adds no treasury membership, extra cash row, invoice/stock effect, or duplicate allocation pool.
Multiple remittance facts can share one cash_out only within its existing positive-only allocated.max_prefix capacity.

mechanism.fact: Typed REJECT references to cash_out and claim_account; source_at is derived with @rebase-depends on cash_out.effective_at.
mechanism.claim_effect: At effective_at the fact posts payable -amount and net +amount to the selected claim_account.z_history.
mechanism.cash_capacity_effect: The same fact posts allocated +amount once to cash_out.z_allocations. Existing cash_out allocation cap and claim payable floor validate the two roots atomically.
mechanism.cash_effect: No treasury membership is emitted by the fact; cash_out already posts the one real treasury debit.

probe.output: Accounting H4b5b tax payable remittance, shared capacities, lifecycle, rollback, and no-duplicate-cash passed
checks: Direct payable 12 plus actual cash_out 12 plus explicit remittance 12 at exactly the cash-out effective_at leaves claim payable 0, cash_out allocated 12, and treasury balance -12 exactly once; equal source/remittance time is accepted.
Independent row reconstruction verifies claim payable/net, cash_out allocation, and treasury balance from explicit payable, remittance, and cash_out rows.
Two remittances of 6 and 4 share a cash_out of 10 successfully; a further 0.01 rejects with complete snapshot equality, isolating the cash-source cap while payable remains sufficient.
A payable of 7, cash_out of 12, and remittance of 8 rejects under the claim payable floor while the separate cash-out allocation capacity remains unused.

Zero, negative, excess-precision amount 1.001, wrong typed source, before-cash-out date, entity mismatch, currency mismatch, cash-out party mismatch, and non-tax claim opponent reject with full snapshot equality.

Amount edit over capacity and effective-time rekey before cash-out reject atomically. After a valid remittance amount edit to 11, reducing cash_out.amount to 10 rejects with full snapshot equality. Moving cash_out.effective_at after an existing remittance rejects through the tracked source_at dependency.

Valid amount and effective-time edits preserve the remittance ID; source or claim-account deletion rejects while referenced; deletion removes claim/allocation effects; re-addition at the same ID restores them without another treasury debit.

commands.result: passed; complete-key algebra, adjacent intervals, tie-order independence and rollback

limits: The fact settles direct claim_account tax payables; existing payable_cash_allocation still targets standalone payable records and was not migrated.
The route records an explicit amount and claims no statutory rate, legal remittance duty, eligibility interpretation, or cross-account netting permission.
Invoice outstanding complete-time guard and stock quantity guard are not changed; stock-floor work remains H5. No production migration is claimed.
